# Licence of the vendored RML-IO source test cases

RML-IO (c) by W3C Community Group on Knowledge Graph Construction.

The upstream repository states two licences for this material: its `LICENSE`
file (kept here unchanged as `LICENSE-upstream`) is the Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 International licence, and its README says "RML-IO is licensed
under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License".
This project treats the files as licensed under the stricter of the two,
**CC BY-SA 4.0** (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), and meets
the conditions of both: attribution (this file, `PROVENANCE.md` and the
project's `NOTICE`), a link to the licence, and an indication of changes
(none: the files are byte-identical to upstream; see `PROVENANCE.md` for which
files were taken). ShareAlike applies to adaptations of the material; the
files are not adapted, and the test runner that reads them is not an
adaptation of them.

These files are test fixtures. They are not compiled into the Open Triplestore
binary or copied into its Docker image, and this project's AGPL-3.0 + Commons
Clause licence does not apply to them.
